interface.projection: CS:4EF7,4EF9,4EFB,4EFD little-endian words map in order to RandomState.word[0..3]. CS:4EF8 is word0's high byte.
interface.recurrence: M=65536; (c0,a)=divmod(bound+s0,M); (c1,b)=divmod(s1+a+c0,M); (c2,c)=divmod(s2+b+c1,M); (c3,d)=divmod(s3+c+c2,M); new=( (a+d+c3) mod M, b,c,d ). Final addition carry is discarded.
interface.range_reduction: Multiply-high, never modulo or rejection. Zero/one return zero. For nonzero B the result is <B, including B=65535. Conditional on a uniform new word, bucket k has ceil((k+1)*65536/B)-ceil(k*65536/B) preimages. Counts differ by at most one, equal only when B divides 65536. This states reduction bias, not uniformity of the bound-dependent generator.
interface.seeding: INT21 AH=2C supplies CH hours, CL minutes, DH seconds, DL hundredths. Only DH replaces the previous word0 high byte; no mixing, recurrence step, or reset of the remaining 56 state bits. Native takes the time record as a parameter.

callers.continuation: CLD then MOV AX,0013 and INT10. Time outputs are not consumed there; bridge conservatively preserves the service shell.
AX bound is (320+WaterYPixels) mod 65536; CMP AX,320 consumes the returned position and replaces flags. Random helper restores CX/DX. State is retained for every future respawn.
